meta.phase-name: Schema-First Content Source and Kaplay Codegen Wiring

phase-summary.outcome: A single repo-authored content source document now drives generated runtime contract assets, content-pack bundles carry the explicit schema document, and the default Kaplay bundle source was regenerated from that authored source.

changes.change: Added `contracts/source/content-source.json` as the authored schema/content root and `contracts/schemas/content-source.schema.json` as the top-level JSON Schema definition.
Added `generate-contract-source-assets.mjs` and wired engine build/bundle scripts to generate runtime contract JSON files from the source document.
Updated bundle generation to include `contentSchema` and `contentSource` packs.
Exported `CONTENT_SCHEMA_DOCUMENT` from the engine and added it to Kaplay runtime parity checks.
Updated content-pack manifest/report/build routes to read schema rows from `contentSchema` first and removed generated manifest/report `spaces` fields.
Regenerated `docs-site/public/game/content-pack.bundle.v1.json` from the schema-first bundle path.

requriements-suggestions.item: Next schema work should move more gameplay pack structure into stricter referenced JSON Schemas instead of treating the pack payloads as loose objects.
When the import/export UI is revisited, it should import/export `content-source.json` directly rather than patching only `spaceVectors` fragments.
